newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL continues its surge, hits new high.
newsitem.headline: MOL continues its surge, hits new high.

text.p: Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt shares continued their surge on the Budapest bourse on Tuesday amid strong demand from local investors and sales by foreigners, traders said.
MOL opened at 3,295 forints, well above Monday's closing level of 3,200 forints and rose to a new high of 3,480 forints. At 1151 GMT MOL shares stood at 3,440 forints, up 240.
MOL's more than eight percent rally continues a total of more than 10 percent rise in the past two days, buoyed by a wage settlement and market expectations of good profits for 1996.
But traders warned that this rally might be too rapid ahead of a new phase in MOL's privatisation.
"I think MOL's price is very high," one trader said, adding that "my perception is that MOL cannot be sold at this price."
Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt has not yet brought any public decision over the sale of a new stake in MOL but many market participants expect it for February.
